name: Money flow path
oneLiner: 2 to 4 glass glyph tiles (bank, you, the thing) joined by glowing tracks: a spinning gold coin rides each arrow in turn and the tile it lands on rings with light; then an accent arc carries coin after coin back the other way and its label is stamped on
say: when the speaker explains where the money goes ('the bank lends you the money, you buy the car, then you pay them back every month'): each coin rides on its step, the arc and its stamp land on the payback
